name: AI system risk assessment
description: Assessment areas from the SentinelGRC specification, organized by NIST AI RMF function as a navigation aid. Written for this project; it does not reproduce official framework text and does not determine legal status.

questions.questionText: Who is accountable for this AI system (business owner, technical owner, risk owner), and how are decisions about it escalated?
Which internal AI, data and security policies apply, and how does the system comply with them?
Describe the intended purpose, intended users and deployment context.
What reasonably foreseeable misuse has been identified, and how is it prevented or detected?
Who could be affected by the system's outputs, and what is the potential impact on them?
Do outputs influence decisions about individuals (e.g. employment, credit, access to services)?
Describe the provenance, quality controls and representativeness of training, fine-tuning and input data.
If personal data is processed, what is the legal basis and how are retention and data-subject rights handled?
How are access to the model, prompts, outputs and configuration controlled and logged?
How has the system been tested against prompt injection and malicious inputs, and what were the results?
Which third-party models, providers or components are used, and have they been assessed?
How is output quality and reliability measured, against which thresholds, and how often?
How are failures, drift and degraded performance detected and handled?
Where relevant and lawful, how has the system been evaluated for bias across affected groups? If not relevant, explain why.
What documentation exists (model card, limitations), and are users told they are interacting with AI?
How can a human review, override or stop the system's outputs, and who is authorized to do so?
What is the incident response, rollback and retirement plan for this system?
How are model, provider and intended-purpose changes reviewed before release?
Which laws and regulations may apply (e.g. GDPR, EU AI Act), and has legal review been requested? Record conclusions as preliminary.
